authored_bible.title: The Weight of Crossing
authored_bible.synopsis: Gonagi and Dana cross into a world that doesn't recognize them, and earn their place in it one scene at a time — from a disoriented arrival at its threshold, through the loneliness and labor of not yet belonging, to a return to that same threshold now on their own terms.
themes: duty as the price of entry
